Austria's leading company - CBmed is a center for biomarker research in medicine with headquarter in Graz. It links excellent research infrastructure, scientific expertise, medical knowledge, national and international industry partners for systematic medical biomarker research.

To strengthen our team in Graz, we are seeking to recruit an ambitious, committed 1 Bioinformatician/Data Engineer (f/m/d) Your tasks and responsibilities:

 * Develop, standardize and execute data processing pipelines (ETL) for biomedical data

 * Taking on the role of a data steward, ensuring that all data activities are documented and follow the highest quality and cyber security standards

 * Work together with IT team to automate ETL processes

 * Work with existing relational databases and object stores (on-prem and cloud)

 * Improve existing in-house web applications for data access and visualization for both in-house as well as scientific and industry partners

 * Contribute to in-house python-based feature extraction pipelines for raw laboratory output (e.g. microscope images) together with data scientists

 * Work together with laboratory scientists

 

Expected skills and abilities:

 * You have/are completing an MSc in bioinformatics, computer science, or related fields

 * You are experienced with python and R for ETL and data analysis

 * You have experience with the Linux command line

 * You have hands-on experience with relational databases, in particular MySQL

 * Optional plus: First hands-on experience with Docker

 * Optional plus: Experience with python for data visualization and web development

 

Expected soft-skills:

 * Precise and reliable working: you have strong focus on delivering precise results according to specifications, including documentation of your work and delivering on time

 * Independent and pro-active working style

 * Good listening, communication, and personal skills to cooperate with lab colleagues

 * Very good command of English, written and spoken

 

Optional and beneficial skills include experience with:

 * Collaborative working tools (git, ticketing systems)

 * Experience with biomedical data (e.g., pathology images, flow cytometry, NGS, metabolomics, microbiome, ...)

 * Experience with image analysis and computer vision (including machine learning and conventional methods)

 * Working in an ISO certified environment

 * German language skills are a plus, but not required to thrive in this position

 

What we offer:

 * Flexible workhours with possibility of home office

 * Family-friendly environment

 * Jobticket

 * You will have the opportunity to work in an internationally connected company, within a motivated and dedicated team

 * Your work on improving and maintaining our data pipelines will directly impact patient well-being, both in the short-term through drug screening approaches and in the long-term through state-of-the-art biomarker research

 * Opportunity to learn new tools and shape your own work experience by using the technology and tools of your choice

 * We offer an unlimited contract with a minimum annual salary from € 58000 gross based on 40 hours/week. Overpayment is possible, depending on qualifications and work experience.

 

CBmed lives an inclusion and supportive work culture. We encourage diversity across all levels. Our common goal is enabling precision medicine.

Diversity enriches our work. We welcome applications from people from all walks of life and with a variety of experiences.

CENTER FOR BIOMARKER RESEARCH IN MEDICINE

1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT.
 * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements.
 * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise.
 * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage.
 * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics.
 * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required.
 * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus.
 * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems.
 * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.

jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.

1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing.
 * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS).

 * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz.

 * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies.
 * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences.
 * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering

Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered.

 * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry
 * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team

Your future responsibilities
We are seeking a motivated Master Student to carry out a Master Thesis in the field of nonlinear integrated photonics, in collaboration with an established industrial and research partner. You will work on the implementation and analysis of coherent modulation schemes, including IQ modulation for carrier-suppressed single-sideband (CS-SSB) operation and dual-sideband modulation.
